description_html:
The trader Painter is required for this mod

It’s VERY IMPORTANT that the trader is loaded BEFORE SandCore

Elevate your SPTarkov gaming experience with “SandCore”, an immersive weapon and weapon mod retexture. Dive deep into the grainy dunes and feel the essence of the desert with each pull of the trigger. Right now these weapons are retextured into FDE: AK101-105, M4A1, SIG MCX. More to come!

The modded items are sold by Painter. You can also find the modded weapons and mods in the flea market. Search for “Sand” in the search box to see all items from SandCore. Report any bugs in the support thread. I will not answer them in the comments. Other questions are okay to ask there though (feedback, requests, etc).

  • Hand-Crafted Details - Every texture is a product of painstaking craftsmanship, ensuring an unparalleled aesthetic appeal.
  • Desert Theme - Immerse yourself in a sand-colored (Flat Dark Earth) aesthetic that’s more than just a color – it’s a vibe.
  • Enhanced Arsenal - Over 30 items, including mods and weapons, completely revamped to fit into the desert theater of operations.
  • **New Weapon Variations -**Discover 7 brand new weapon variations, each tailored with the FDE theme, bringing a fresh tactical angle to your arsenal.

How you install this mod:

Download Painter

Drag the folder in the zip file into your SPT directory

Download this mod

Drag the folder in the zip file into your SPT directory

You did it!

If you use custom load order, you have to make sure Painter is loading before my other mods.

Mix and match FDE with other textured item colors for a very unique look
